metadata_comment_syntax.deck: At the start of the file: <!-- markdown-pptx:deck on its own line, YAML settings, then --> on its own line.
metadata_comment_syntax.slide: Immediately after an H1 heading: <!-- markdown-pptx:slide on its own line, YAML settings, then --> on its own line.
metadata_comment_syntax.legacy_yaml_front_matter: Unsupported. Metadata must use named HTML comments.

master_selector_syntax: Use a positive 1-based master index, or an exact unique slide-master/theme name reported by --list-masters.

table_options.scope: Slide-level options applied to every table on the slide. Require at least one pipe table.

two_content_syntax: Explicit layout: Two Content requires exactly one top-level thematic break. Content before it goes left and content after it goes right. Prefer *** surrounded by blank lines. --- and ___ also work when parsed as thematic breaks. Either area can be empty, text flow, one image, one table, or one video. Require exactly two non-overlapping body/content placeholders arranged left to right. Nested breaks and additional breaks are rejected.

video_syntax.form: A standalone Markdown link to an MP4 or YouTube URL becomes a video. A linked image to an MP4 uses the image as its poster. An optional adjacent markdown-pptx:video HTML comment holds non-default YAML settings. One video occupies a Title and Content area or one side of Two Content.
video_syntax.example:
[![Play demo](media/poster.png)](media/demo.mp4)

<!-- markdown-pptx:video
width: 75%
start: automatic
loop: true
mute: true
fullscreen: true
-->
video_syntax.source: The standalone link destination is a local MP4 path, HTTPS MP4 URL, or YouTube watch, share, Shorts, or embed URL. Relative paths resolve from the Markdown directory. Absolute paths use the current operating system. Inline links remain hyperlinks.
video_syntax.width: auto, a percentage such as 75%, or inches such as 6in. Always fitted within the content area.
video_syntax.aspect_ratio: Optional width:height ratio. Defaults to the MP4 display aspect ratio or 16:9 for YouTube.
video_syntax.align: left, center, or right. Default center.
video_syntax.valign: top, middle, or bottom. Default middle.

mp4_only.linked_poster: Use a local linked image as the link label for a custom MP4 poster. Default first decoded frame. No poster setting is supported.
mp4_only.start: click or automatic. Default click. Playback does not advance the slide when it ends.
mp4_only.mute: Boolean, default false. False uses PowerPoint high volume.

video_syntax.remote_mp4: Downloaded and embedded. Default maximum is 100 decimal MB. Use --max-remote-video-mb or --no-remote-videos.
video_syntax.youtube: Online video. No poster or native playback settings. A linked image to YouTube remains an ordinary clickable image. Playback needs an internet connection.

theme_color_syntax: Use var(--slot-name) in text colors and backgrounds, for example var(--accent-1) or var(--dark-1).
example:
---
aspect_ratio: "16:9"
fonts:
  body: Aptos
  headings: Aptos Display
color_scheme:
  preset: Office
title_color: "var(--dark-1)"
body_color: "var(--dark-1)"
background: "linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-1) 0%, var(--accent-2) 100%)"
---

# Title slide
---
master: 1
layout: Title Slide
notes: |
  Introduce the deck.
---

A concise subtitle line.

# Overview
---
layout: Title and Content
title_color: "var(--light-1)"
body_color: "var(--light-1)"
background: "linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-1) 0%, var(--accent-2) 100%)"
---

## Goals
- Keep the markdown readable
- Use real PowerPoint placeholders
- Fail on ambiguous mappings

code_highlighting.inheritance: Slides inherit the document setting. Explicit default restores Pygments colors.
code_highlighting.variants: theme-dark means dark code on a light background. theme-light means light code on a dark background.
code_highlighting.analysis: Solid colors, cropped image samples with 1% tails removed, or a 16 by 16 gradient grid. One analysis per code content placeholder. Native theme brightness adjustments preserve the requested variant.
code_highlighting.limits: Images and gradients are estimates. Overlaid template graphics are not composited. Unsupported backgrounds use an explicit assumption. Impossible contrast produces a warning.
code_highlighting.report: JSON code_highlighting entries include minimum_contrast, target_met, and warnings. target_met is null for an assumed background. Plain CLI warnings go to stderr.

reference_syntax: Definitions apply across the deck, including slide titles. Full, collapsed, and shortcut references work. Definitions may appear before the first slide after the deck metadata comment. The first normalized label wins. Definitions inside code or HTML comments are not collected. Unresolved references remain literal. Optional text and picture link titles become ScreenTips. Picture titles remain separate metadata.
list_content_syntax: Continuation paragraphs, code, and headings retain their containing list indentation. Nested lists inside quotes count toward the three-level limit. HTML comments are ignored. Images inside lists are rejected. Ordered values outside 1..32767 use editable text prefixes without automatic PowerPoint renumbering. Template paragraph spacing is preserved.
